text: The fourth Peking University Summer School International will run from July 2 to July 27, 2015. Our program integrates the best of Peking University's teaching resources and aims to provide a stage for communication and learning between global students. The program offers ten content courses and one Chinese language course. The subjects of the content courses will be related to philosophy, economics, public policy, sociology, culture, literature and music. All the content courses will be taught in English. All courses will be held at the Peking University campus. Students will receive an official transcript from Peking University upon completion of the program. When applying online, you should choose two courses from below items and Chinese language course is optional: China since 1949 Population Ageing and Health Local traditions and Chinese Society Communication,Culture, and Society: The Chinese Way Transition and Public Policy in China Society and Politics in China Modern Chinese Literature and Culture (1890-1990) Chinese Foreign Policy The China Factor-Managing China's Global Challenges Silk Roads Topics on Chinese Economy Chinese Folklore and Culture Flower in the Mirror: the Chinaman and his Values Application Deadline:April 23, 2015 Admission Time:Admission Letters and Visa Application Forms (JW202) will be mailed out before May 10th, 2015 Program Duration:July 2-July 27, 2015 Fees:Tuition Fee RMB 10,000 Note: 1. The application fee is non-refundable. 2. The non-refundable tuition fee of 10,000 RMB covers two content courses, one Chinese Language course and visits to several historical and cultural attractions of Beijing. An extra 3,500 RMB of each course should be paid if student chooses more than two contents courses. 3. The tuition fee should be wired to Peking University bank account no later than May 31st, 2015, once an offer of admission is made. Otherwise, it can be deemed to be a waiver. 4. Occasionally we are forced to cancel courses if its enrollment is less than 10. Should your course be subject to a major change we will notify you in due time. In that case, you may either transfer to another course for which you are qualified.
